_meta.description: Operator-extensible AnalyticalDimension register + GLLine segment P&L roll-up aggregations. Lands the parts of bookkeeping-cost-centers-dimensions/tasks.md that the prior consultancy-project-accounting build deferred (Tasks 7, 9, 10). CostCenter + Project schemas already live in shillinq_register.json; GLLine.dimensions field already declared there too. This fragment adds the AnalyticalDimension schema, segment-P&L aggregations on GLLine (per-cost-center, per-project, per-dimension), and 3 cost-center + 2 project + 2 analytical-dimension seed objects.

AnalyticalDimension.title: Analytical Dimension
AnalyticalDimension.description: Operator-defined custom analytical dimension (Region, Product Line, Department, etc.) per REQ-CD-006. Each declared dimension becomes a key in GLLine.dimensions and surfaces as a filter / group-by in the segment P&L aggregations declared on GLLine. The OR relations engine validates that GLLine.dimensions keys reference an active AnalyticalDimension.code per administration.

code.description: Stable operator-facing dimension code, unique per administration. Referenced as a key in GLLine.dimensions.

name.description: Human-readable dimension name shown in the operator UI and segment P&L drill-down.

description.description: Optional long-form description of the dimension and its intended use.

dataType.description: JSON value type for the dimension. `reference` indicates the value MUST be a slug of another register (operator picks the target register via referenceRegister/referenceSchema below).

isHierarchical.description: When true, the dimension supports parent-child roll-up via a `parentCode` self-relation on the dimension values. Drives drill-down navigation.

referenceRegister.description: When dataType=`reference`, the slug of the register the dimension value references (typically `shillinq`).

referenceSchema.description: When dataType=`reference`, the slug of the schema the dimension value references (e.g. `Contact`, `Project`).

administrationId.description: Owning administratie. Dimensions are scoped per administration; the same dimension code MAY exist with different metadata across administrations.

lifecycleState.description: Operator-managed activation state. Archived dimensions remain referenced from historical GLLine.dimensions but cannot be selected on new postings.

sortOrder.description: Display order in the operator UI.

referenceTarget.description: When dataType=`reference`, the dimension value MUST resolve to an object of (referenceRegister, referenceSchema). Validated by the OR relations engine.

byCostCenter.description: Per-cost-center roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration per REQ-CD-004. Surfaces segment P&L per CostCenter.code (joined to CostCenter.name for the drill-down). Declared declaratively per ADR-031 — no PHP SegmentReportService walks the GL.

byCostCenterHierarchy.description: Hierarchical roll-up of GL amounts per CostCenter.parentCode tree per REQ-CD-007. Child cost-center sums propagate to parents through the self-relation; drives drill-down navigation in the segment P&L view. Declarative (ADR-031).

byProject.description: Per-project roll-up of posted GL amounts within an administration per REQ-CD-004. Surfaces project P&L for consultancy and grant-funded work. Declarative (ADR-031).

byAnalyticalDimension.description: Per-custom-dimension roll-up of posted GL amounts per REQ-CD-006. Each registered AnalyticalDimension contributes a group-by key drawn from GLLine.dimensions[code]. Drives the operator-extensible segment P&L surface; new dimensions appear automatically without PHP/Vue edits.

objects.name: Region
objects.description: Geographic region (e.g. Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland). Surfaces regional P&L per municipality / branch.

objects.name: Product Line
objects.description: Product line (e.g. Hosting, Consulting, Training). Surfaces product-mix P&L for revenue-side analytics.

objects.name: Sales Utrecht
objects.description: Sales team based in Utrecht (Randstad-Oost coverage).
